closed_interfaces.name: QX_free
closed_interfaces.statement: For typed M,R,E of arity one and E.shift=E, (QX M R E).free = GF (MpT M.shift zT) (lift1 R.free) E.
closed_interfaces.reason: The triply lifted opening vector maps its four entries to #0,#1,#2,&0. The equality and econs leaves retain their exact argument order. There is no assumption M is shift-fixed; retaining M.shift is required for MT_succ.
